fields.currently_building: Audio Business ERP + POS system in Django

fields.title: KiddingZone
fields.tagline: Production kids' bike & gear review platform built with Django and Wagtail CMS
fields.description: A full-featured content platform for kids' bike and cycling gear reviews. Built with Django 6 + Wagtail CMS, featuring product review pages with star ratings and affiliate links, best-picks roundup pages, a helmet sizer tool, author trust system with E-E-A-T schema, IndexNow integration for instant search indexing, comparison tool, and full JSON-LD schema.org markup. Deployed with Docker + Nginx + PostgreSQL/PostGIS.

fields.title: Anonymous Intel Platform
fields.tagline: A secure platform for people to share experiences without fear of victimization
fields.description: An anonymous intelligence-gathering platform designed for safe disclosure. People can share workplace incidents, community concerns, and experiences without identity exposure. Features end-to-end anonymization, category tagging, and moderation tools.

fields.title: Audio Business ERP + POS
fields.tagline: Full-featured ERP and point-of-sale system built for audio equipment businesses
fields.description: A comprehensive business management system for audio equipment businesses — covering inventory, sales, rentals, service tracking, staff management, and financial reporting. Designed as a modular Django ERP with an integrated POS interface.

fields.title: AirBnB Clone — REST API
fields.tagline: Complete AirBnB backend clone with a full RESTful API in Python + Flask
fields.description: A comprehensive backend clone of AirBnB, progressed through three versions. Version 3 implements a full RESTful API with Flask, covering authentication, state/city/place/amenity management, and dual file/database storage engines with SQLAlchemy. Built during the ALX Africa program.

fields.title: Simple Shell
fields.tagline: A UNIX command-line interpreter written from scratch in C
fields.description: A fully functional UNIX shell implementation in C that replicates core shell behavior: command parsing, process execution via fork/execve, PATH resolution, built-in commands (cd, exit, env), signal handling, and error management. Built collaboratively through the ALX Africa program — demonstrates deep systems programming fundamentals.

fields.title: Garibuntu
fields.tagline: ALX Africa portfolio project — full-stack Python web application
fields.description: A portfolio project built during the ALX Africa Software Engineering Program. A full-stack web application deployed to Vercel demonstrating end-to-end Python web development.
